question: Will the self-directed controller keep delivering and choose a useful amount of neighbour advice when the objective changes from headline clicks to memorable dialogue? Use the already existing anonymous Cornell Movie-Quotes research task (not H2, and not a first encounter by the project as a whole). No model decisions or weights carry over from headline runs.
inputs: Reuse the byte-identical prior training-only 1744-row package and separate 450-row feature package. The held films, connected components and normalized quotes have no overlap with fitting data according to the frozen source protocol. Same ordinary unified solve, complete modular directory, 16 actual-fit limit, 1800 seconds, no model/order/planner hints. Control uses previously shipped dynamic discovery source; revised uses the multi-incumbent adviser controller. Each may select any eligible method or abstain. The analysis protocol and the movie titles/film clusters are never provided to the solver.
scoring: Seal both outputs and full training records. Verify uncached fresh-process predictions on all 450 before reading the external scoring-only JSON once. Report correct, row-level changes, actual fits, film counts and proportion of films with net improvement or worsening when the relevant stored group IDs exist. This is a single familiar public development source, not a claim about every unknown task. No official course data, course validation, H2 or paid model APIs.
budget: At most 32 supervised fits for both movie treatments combined. Reuse the same raw input split; do not tune from the 450 labels or run a second choice of weights on them.
